column1: # ISO 639 languages for internal/langs. Run `go generate ./internal/langs` after editing.
#   code      ISO 639-1 code, or a regional tag "<639-1>-<region>" (canonical, lower case)
#   iso2b     ISO 639-2/B code ("-" on regional rows: they inherit the base's)
#   name      English name, as shown in the UI
#   aliases   other spellings that mean exactly this entry, comma-separated, lower case
#             ("-" for none): alternative names, retired codes, other tools' codes
#   opensubs  OpenSubtitles.com language code ("-" = the code itself)
